desc: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, please find enclosed herewith Newspaper Advertisement regarding Notice of the 32nd Annual General Meeting and related Shareholder matters.
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 34 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, we enclosed herewith the Notice convening the 32nd Annual General Meeting of the Company.
Pursuant to Regulation 34(1) of the SEBI Listing Regulations, we hereby enclose the 32nd Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 of the Company.
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, we enclosed herewith e-mail communication sent to Shareholders for deduction of Tax at Source on Final Dividend.
Pursuant to Regulation 36(1)(b) of the SEBI Listing Regulations, we enclosed herewith letter communication sent to Shareholders.
